extracted.stage: Financial provision action proceeding to proof
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for the pursuer in a financial provision action at Glasgow Sheriff Court asks whether we fund £22,500 of costs to proof, with matrimonial property of about £225,000.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry and for the background on your client's financial provision action. To consider it further we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction in which the proceedings are raised, details of the matrimonial property and any existing security or charges over it, the expected timetable including any diet or hearing dates, and a costs estimate through to proof. Please also confirm your client's details and your firm's contact for correspondence. We will review the information once received and come back to you; nothing in this message constitutes an offer of funding or any indication of terms.
